title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study S2)
description: Study S2 of the bigP3BCI collection, a large open P300-based brain-computer interface EEG dataset. It contains recordings from 24 healthy participants who used a 9x8 speller grid with a house/tool stimulus paradigm, with target and non-target flashes annotated using HED. The data were recorded at 256 Hz from 32 channels and are formatted for machine learning and benchmarking with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) from 32 channels at a 256 Hz sampling rate, using a standard 10-20 montage. Participants completed one session each in a laboratory setting. The task was a P300 speller with online feedback, with a calibration phase followed by testing. Epochs cover 0 to 1.0 s after each stimulus.
